newsitem.title: USA: Gingrich calls for "honest" Clinton budget plan.
newsitem.headline: Gingrich calls for "honest" Clinton budget plan.

text.p: Republican House Speaker Newt Gingrich on Friday called on President Clinton to submit an "honest" balanced budget plan, saying the one the president proposed in February would be $62 billion in deficit in the year 2002.
"Please submit an honest balanced budget that is real," Gingrich said in a speech to the National Federation of Republican Women.
Referring to Clinton's budget proposal, Gingrich said, "It doesn't work. The numbers are wrong."
Gingrich also called on Clinton to withdraw his plan to charge tolls on some interstate highways.
"This is double taxation. I am calling on the president to withdraw this proposal for double taxation. If the era of big government is over, we don't need toll roads," Gingrich said.
